profile.description: Encompass Health Corporation, formerly Amcare and HealthSouth, based in Birmingham, Alabama, is the United States's largest provider of inpatient rehabilitative services, offering facility-based care through its network of 173 inpatient rehabilitation hospitals located in 39 states and Puerto Rico.
profile.description_zh: Encompass Health Corporation（前身为Amcare和HealthSouth）总部位于阿拉巴马州伯明翰，是美国最大的住院康复服务提供商，通过其覆盖39个州和波多黎各的173家住院康复医院网络提供基于设施的护理服务。
